summary.text: Rose Martinez is the Democratic candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election, seeking to return to a seat she held from 2022 to 2024.
A policy analyst, she faces Republican incumbent Julie Reyes Oda, who defeated her in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Rose Martinez ran unsuccessfully for Hawaii House of Representatives District 40 in 2018 and 2020, losing both times to incumbent Republican Bob McDermott.
She won the seat in the November 8, 2022 general election, defeating Janie Gueso, and served from November 8, 2022, to November 5, 2024.
In the 2023-2024 session, Martinez was vice chair of the Culture and Arts Committee and also served on the House Education, Higher Education and Labor and Government Operations committees.
Julie Reyes Oda defeated Martinez in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Martinez advanced from the Democratic primary on August 8, 2026, and faces Oda in the general election.
